items.prompt:
Improving the ideas and organization of a draft is:
A) revising
B) editing
C) printing

Fixing spelling and punctuation is:
A) editing
B) revising
C) planning

Feedback from classmates is called:
A) peer feedback
B) a conclusion
C) a citation

A reader says your thesis is unclear and your paragraphs wander. Fixing this is:
A) revising
B) editing
C) proofreading

You fix a dangling modifier and two misspellings. This is:
A) editing
B) revising
C) planning

Adding stronger evidence to better serve the purpose is:
A) revising
B) editing
C) formatting

Which change is REVISING, not editing?
A) rewriting the thesis and reorganizing the body to sharpen the argument
B) fixing a typo
C) adding a missing period
items.answer: A) rewriting the thesis and reorganizing the body to sharpen the argument

solution.answer: A) rewriting the thesis and reorganizing the body to sharpen the argument

items.prompt:
The BEST reason to focus revision on PURPOSE and AUDIENCE is to:
A) ensure the writing addresses what matters most for its intended reader
B) copy a classmate's work
C) avoid revising
items.answer: A) ensure the writing addresses what matters most for its intended reader

solution.answer: A) ensure the writing addresses what matters most for its intended reader
